name: Hatred Unleashed
descriptionTemplate: Deal [Damage:Arg1] DMG to, and inflict an equal amount of {Bleed} on all enemies. Gain [Power:Arg2] {STR}.
lore:
Lachesis holds a long ruler, singing about the life of the Tylos:
Sparta's killer, you could have been a hero,
Tisiphone blinded your eyes, her wings became your bonds,
She made you a slave to hatred, seeing only red.
